name: Silent Turtle 50
author: Gautammsharma
description: Rounded red button that glows on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #ff7675 to #fdcb6e, box-shadow becomes 4px 4px 0px #e17055, transform becomes translate(2px, 2px).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Silent Turtle 50</title>
<style>
/* Silent Turtle 50 by Gautammsharma — https://uiverse.io/Gautammsharma/silent-turtle-50 */
.comic-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 1rem 2rem;
  border-radius: 2rem;
  border: none;
  background-color: #ff7675;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-shadow: 2px 2px #000;
  box-shadow: 6px 6px 0px #d63031;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.comic-btn:hover {
  background-color: #fdcb6e;
  box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px #e17055;
  transform: translate(2px, 2px);
}

.comic-btn:active {
  background-color: #e17055;
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px #d63031;
  transform: translate(6px, 6px);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="comic-btn">Click me!</button>

</body>
</html>
